product.description: Monoprice™Wireless Car Charging Mount – Qi2® Certified, 15W, for iPhone® 12-17 & Galaxy S25/S26 SeriesSecure and Effortless Power for Every DriveThis Qi2-certified wireless car charging mount delivers fast, reliable charging while keeping your smartphone securely positioned and easy to view on the road. Built on the Qi2 standard with Magnetic Power Profile (MPP), it ensures precise magnetic alignment for more consistent power delivery and improved charging efficiency—helping eliminate the misalignment and intermittent charging issues common with traditional wireless car chargers. With support for up to 15W of wireless charging for compatible devices, it keeps your phone powered throughout daily commutes and longer drives.Designed for real-world driving conditions, the integrated magnetic mounting system holds your phone firmly in place, even over bumps and uneven roads. A 360-degree ball joint allows quick adjustment between portrait and landscape orientations, making it easy to follow navigation, manage calls, or control music hands-free. The built-in vent clamp provides secure, tool-free installation on most vehicle air vents, keeping your device within a comfortable and safe viewing position.For a truly hassle-free setup, the mount includes a USB-C® PD car charger and USB-C cable, delivering up to 20W of input power to support optimal wireless charging performance right out of the box. Broad compatibility ensures seamless charging for iPhone 12–17 series devices; Samsung® Galaxy S25 Ultra, S25+, S25, and S26 models (with a Qi2- or MagSafe®-compatible case); and other Qi2-enabled smartphones.
